qualitative_result: All six reviewed answer sets identify the intended activities, correct the imperfect time clue, and retain uncertainty for the ambiguous reply. No unsupported extra claims were found.
limitations: Single synthetic corpus with templated background documents and approved entity names.
Ten correlated prompts, two fresh agents per arm; no statistical significance claim.
Lexical only; no embedding-based semantic retrieval was tested.
Tool wall times include full-source integrity scans and concurrent execution; they are not pure retrieval latency.
kickoff_path_note: Replicate2 KG received an immediate path-only correction. Actual wrapper calls and answer-file writes used the correct directory; no failure or additional data call resulted.
